senses.definition: n.[m.] progeny, posterity, always c. נִין in standing phr. (Ecclus 41:5; 47:22c, both c. נין);—abs. לֹא נִין לוֹ וְלֹא נ׳ בְּעַמּוֹ Jb 18:19, cf. שֵׁם וּשְׁאָר וְנִין וְנ׳ Is 14:22; sf. לִי וּלְנִינִי וּלְנֶכְדִּי Gn 21:23 to me and to my offspring and to my posterity.
